headline: Deepak Builders CFO Parveen Kumari resigns
summary: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has announced the cessation of Ms. Parveen Kumari as its Chief Financial Officer. The resignation is effective from October 10, 2026. The company has not yet disclosed a successor for the position.
why_it_matters: Leadership changes in finance can signal internal management shifts.

headline: Deepak Builders & Engineers changes its registered office address
hook: Routine corporate filing from Deepak Builders
summary: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has formally notified the stock exchanges about a change in its registered office address. The administrative update involves no financial transactions or operational shifts. Indian retail investors hold no direct stakes affected by this procedural move.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your investments.
